  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((i >= d_start and i < (d_start + k)) or result[i] == dest[i])
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (not (i >= d_start and i < (d_start + k)) or result[i] == src[(s_start + (i - d_start))])
  effects pure
  example copy_range([0, 0, 0], 1, [7, 8, 9], 0, 2) == [0, 7, 8]
  example copy_range([1, 2, 3], 0, [9, 9], 0, 0) == [1, 2, 3]
{
  if k == 0 then dest else copy_range(set(dest, d_start, nth(src, s_start)), d_start + 1, src, s_start + 1, k - 1)
}

fn Copy(src: List[Int], s_start: Int, dest: List[Int], d_start: Int, len_: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (s_start >= 0)
  requires (d_start >= 0)
  requires (len_ >= 0)
  requires (len(src) >= (s_start + len_))
  requires (len(dest) >= (d_start + len_))
  ensures (len(result) == len(dest))
  ensures forall i in 0..d_start: (result[i] == dest[i])
  ensures forall i in (d_start + len_)..len(result): (result[i] == dest[i])
  ensures forall i in 0..len_: (result[(d_start + i)] == src[(s_start + i)])
  effects pure
  example Copy([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 1, [10, 20, 30, 40, 50], 2, 3) == [10, 20, 2, 3, 4]
{
  copy_range(dest, d_start, src, s_start, len_)
}
